a.lede: Less than a week after an issue with air traffic control communications and radar caused the FAA to halt takeoffs nationwide, United Airlines departing flights are being disrupted by an outage. a.title: United Airlines system outage disrupts departures just days after the big ground stop

b.lede: The FAA has also disabled the other 68 routers that had already been installed.
b.title: FAA suspends installation of router that led to a ground stop of flights across the US
